lines: Atul Hiralal Shah, Investor Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 12,600 shares in the offer for sale, for proceeds of up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold; the employee-portion discount means actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The sale gain is up to ₹1.26 crore before offer expenses and taxes, and the holder retains an estimated ₹3.97 crore in shares at the offer price.
The money has been in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), so the timing fits a call now.

Family link: Atul Hiralal Shah and Bakul Hiralal Shah share the surname Shah and middle name Hiralal. Confidence is medium: the name was verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only (promoter_holding).
